parameters.help_en:
Background audio link  

Upload requirements:  
Only .wav files with a sample rate of 16 kHz and single sound channel are supported. (If your background audio is not in .wav format, you can use ffmpeg to convert it: `ffmpeg -i input_audio -acodec pcm_s16le -ac 1 -ar 16000 output.wav`)  
File size must not exceed 2 MB.  
If the synthesized audio duration exceeds the background audio duration, the background audio will loop during playback
parameters.help_zh:
背景音链接

可使用 ffmpeg将其转为wav格式：ffmpeg -i 输入音频 -acodec pcm_s16le -ac 1 -ar 16000 目标.wav）
大小不超过2MB。
3.合成时长超出背景音时长时，背景音将循环合成播放
